suppress.notes: XsltView SSRF/RCE: the application renders no views (REST/JSON only, no ViewResolver, no XsltView).
Server-Sent Events with view fragments / functional web framework: no SSE and no functional endpoints are used.

WebFlux-only issues (Aalto XML, functional endpoint header predicates, PartEventHttpMessageReader, Jetty 12 reactive adapter, WebSocket): the application uses Spring MVC on Tomcat; WebFlux, Jetty and WebSocket are not on the classpath.
SpEL evaluation (SimpleEvaluationContext compiler bypass, power-operator DoS): the application evaluates no SpEL expressions, in particular none built from user input.
RSocket SETUP frame memory leak: RSocket is not used and not on the classpath.

Data binding of user-supplied property paths (DoS): request bodies are deserialized by Jackson into records (@RequestBody); no @ModelAttribute/WebDataBinder binding of request parameters onto objects is used.

Spring Security embedded UnboundID LDAP server, DPoP JWT decoder, WebAuthn: none of these features is used (HTTP Basic with an in-memory user only); LDAP/OAuth2/WebAuthn modules are not on the classpath.
